title: Major tech outages raise new cybersecurity concerns
summary: "The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley examine a series of recent technology outages affecting Apple (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT), JPMorgan Chase (JPM), and the National Security Agency (NSA). The panel explores the cybersecurity concerns posed by these disruptions and what they reveal about vulnerabilities in critical digital infrastructure.

title: Tech outages are disrupting everything. Are humans to blame?
summary: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen examines a series of major technology outages affecting Microsoft (MSFT), the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), the National Security Agency (NSA), JPMorgan Chase (JPM), Charles Schwab (SCHW), and Apple  (AAPL). From grounded flights to disrupted financial services, Ahamadeen explores what's behind these critical system failures and whether human error, rather than technology itself, is the real culprit.

title: Planes, banks and the NSA all went down in one week
summary: In six days, Microsoft 365 went down, every U.S. flight was grounded, big banks showed $0 balances and the NSA's classified network went offline. Officials blame faulty servers and aging systems. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen walks through each one, asks if it's all a coincidence and breaks down what Google and the FBI revealed about AI-run hacking.

title: What NICE (TASE:NICE)'s Microsoft AI Tie Up Means For Shareholders
summary: In November 2026, NiCE announced a deeper collaboration with Microsoft, bringing NiCE Cognigy AI Agents into Microsoft Teams Phone, Azure, and Dynamics 365 Customer Service so AI and human staff can manage customer interactions as a single blended workforce. The new NiCE Cognigy release focuses on reusable AI skills, integrated speech and language models, and full decision tracing, which together target real operational pain points such as call routing accuracy, handling time, and governance...

title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.

title: Anthropic's $81.3B haul makes it the largest tech IPO ever
summary: AI frontier labs finally have a price tag. Anthropic priced its highly anticipated IPO at $83 a share, above its initial range of $70 to $78, evidence of strong demand. The IPO raised $81.3 billion for Anthropic and its cofounders, valuing the Claude maker at around $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis. title: Costco generators sell out as tech outages spark panic buying
summary: From Microsoft to the FAA, a wave of tech outages has rattled Americans, sparking panic buying that sold out most of Costco’s generators online.

title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella remains confident in Nvidia after Huang’s exit
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella expressed confidence in Jensen Huang's successor Colette Kress, who is serving as Nvidia's interim CEO.

title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
summary: Microsoft's CEO says AI agents could disrupt advertising-driven business models, forcing companies like Amazon to rethink how they compete for customers.
